summary: Reject non-object POST JSON payloads and forward hf.co local Ollama tags in proxy

delivery.outcome: Reject non-object JSON bodies with HTTP 400 INVALID_REQUEST on non-speech POST routes and forward local hf.co GGUF Ollama tags cleanly.
nonGoals: Do not alter speech route payload validation semantics or touch modules outside proxy.py and test_proxy.py.

architecture.decision: Extract _is_unmanaged_local_ollama_model helper in proxy.py for hf.co/... forwarding and guard non-Mapping JSON bodies in do_POST right after speech dispatch.
architecture.rollback: Revert ticket-239 commit via protected PR.

validation.evidence: Non-object POST JSON payloads return 400 INVALID_REQUEST and local hf.co tags forward cleanly with C901 <= 15.
